Strategy: Test the upper-shifted pure bonus band, rewarding leftovers between thirty and forty-five with no penalty. It may help if the higher window suits this seed, but may fail if the lower edge matters more than the upper one.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) for r in bins]
```
